headline: Haleon Bets on Microsoft AI To Support Growth and Reach One Billion More Consumers by 2030
summary: Haleon expands its Microsoft partnership with a five-year AI deal to improve operations, innovation and support its 2030 growth targets.

headline: Sony Ends Physical Discs For Games By 2028, Why GameStop Needs eBay Or Another Growth Plan
summary: A change made by Sony and the PlayStation gaming segment could be more reason for GameStop to acquire eBay.
